fields.summary_ko.0: LLY posted a 45.3% return over six months from May 18, 2026 to November 16, 2026, with Mounjaro and Zepbound achieving over $16 billion in sales, approximately 2/3 of Q3 2026 revenue.
fields.summary_ko.1: Supply increase signals emerged from February 2025 onwards, and despite quarterly revenue growth rates moderating from 55.5% (March) to 38.6% (September), obesity treatment GLP-1 usage grew 82%.
